Hi Liam / Horizon security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — excited to run the two-day workshop at your HQ the week of Oct 4. To make sure check-in is smooth for your facilities/security team and our engineers, could you confirm the following items? We want to avoid any last-minute hold-ups at the lobby.

1) Badging requirements: do visitors need government ID only, or corporate ID + secondary verification? Any photo requirements/camera restrictions?
2) Roster deadline: you mentioned a 72-hour lead time — is that from first arrival or start of day? Preferred file format?
3) Escort rules: are unescorted vendors allowed in any zones, or must someone from Horizon escort at all times?
4) Equipment dropoffs: we plan to deliver 5 loaner laptops and power strips on morning of Oct 4 — do these require advance manifest/insurance docs?
5) Parking & entrance: is visitor parking validated or should we route them to the loading bay? Any vendor loading hours?
6) Prohibited items/policy (cameras, recording, external drives)?

I've attached a visitor_badging_template.xlsx to capture the roster (names, birthdate, company, gov ID type, mobile). Also linking our NDA DocuSign (we can sign before roster).

We’ll route the final roster to the email address you confirm. Looping in Marissa (workshop ops) and Ben (onsite logistics) so they have visibility.

Thanks —
Soojin

Soojin — thanks, this is great. Quick answers below: 

1) Badging: Gov ID (passport or driver's license) plus company ID is preferred for non-registered vendors. If a visitor cannot present both, we will perform a secondary verification with a photo. No specific photo format beyond legible.
2) Roster: 72 hours before first arrival is correct. Preferred as XLSX (your template is fine). Please include name, DOB (mm/dd/yyyy), company, email, phone, ID type and last 4 of ID.
3) Escort: All Redwood staff must be escorted in non-public tenant floors. We can allow a single escort for a group if that escort is Horizon-cleared.
4) Equipment: Please provide an equipment manifest and proof of insurance (COI) in advance — delivery must go through loading dock between 08:00–10:00 only.
5) Parking: Visitor parking is limited — we will validate two visitor spots near the main lobby; otherwise instruct guests to use public drop-off and we will shuttle.
6) Recording: No video recording in executive floors; audio notes OK with prior approval.

I’ll add a security point-of-contact: Andrew Zhao (andrew.zhao@horizon.com). He will need the roster and signed NDA before we issue temporary badges.

Also attaching a short Site Security packet (site_security_q1.pdf) and a link to our internal visitor form. We can accept DocuSign for the NDA.

—Liam
Liam Patel
Program Manager, Facilities & Security
Horizon Financial
